item.title: Flight
item.description: As long as I can remember, I’ve been fascinated by airplanes and the world of aviation. During the pandemic, I decided to finally take the leap and pursue my private pilot’s license, and I couldn’t have been happier with the result. Learning to operate an aircraft all by myself was unforgettable, and the adventures I’ve been able to go on as a result are incredible. I got my private pilot’s license in 2021 and my instrument rating in the summer of 2023.
item.content:
As long as I can remember, I’ve been fascinated by airplanes and the world of aviation. During the pandemic, I decided to finally take the leap and pursue my private pilot’s license, and I couldn’t have been happier with the result. Learning to operate an aircraft all by myself was unforgettable, and the adventures I’ve been able to go on as a result are incredible. I got my private pilot’s license in 2021 and my instrument rating in the summer of 2023.

Flying over Monument Valley on my way back from a day trip to the Grand Canyon.

Over the Napa, CA area during my instrument training.

Flying over the Charles River in Boston, MA in a Piper Warrior.

item.content:
This is a collection of things I made mostly before college, that lived in some form on my old site but not here.

Grooks

The Grooks are a collection of my favorite short poems by the author Piet Hein. I posted one of these each day for my friends, and archived the content in case discord stops storing old messages one day.

DCI

I attended the Alexander Dawson School for High School. While I was there, I was the first student to complete the Distinction in Innovation program and associated award. This process involved building a number of projects, both for classes and for fun. I created a portfolio in the form of a github wiki, and you can view all of the pieces there.
